hero.title: About ACES-ACM
hero.sub: The student society of the CSE department at IIT Delhi, and its ACM Student Chapter.

body: ACES-ACM is the departmental student society of Computer Science & Engineering at IIT Delhi. As the department's ACM Student Chapter, we serve as the bridge between students, faculty, and the wider computing community.

Through the academic year we organise technical workshops, speaker series, research initiatives, hackathons, coding contests, and social events. Our flagship event, the CSE Research Symposium, brings the department's research community together for two days each year — but it is just one of the many things we do.
Our mission is to build a vibrant, inclusive community for every CSE student — helping them learn, build, research, connect, and have fun along the way.
